customManagers.description: Go toolchain: the go directive in go.mod. Renovate's gomod manager has never bumped it here (the two Go version PRs #306 and #323 touched only the Containerfile and the Makefile), so it is matched explicitly and grouped with the Containerfile image by the 'Go version' rule below. Note on the field name, which every custom manager here uses: managerFilePatterns is the current name of what Renovate used to call fileMatch. A locally resolved renovate-config-validator may be Renovate 37, which predates that rename and rejects the field, so a local validation failure on managerFilePatterns means the validator is stale and not that this config is wrong. The Renovate that actually reads this file is renovatebot/github-action@v46.2.5, pinned in .github/workflows/renovate.yml.
Velero e2e: CSI hostpath driver and external snapshotter
Velero e2e: MinIO backend image. Manages the manifest that is applied; MinIO was deleted from Docker Hub and ships no further community releases, so this is expected to find nothing.
Velero e2e: the external-attacher sidecar. The snapshotter and the hostpath driver had managers; these four did not, so they were pinned and never bumped.
Velero e2e: the external-provisioner sidecar. The snapshotter and the hostpath driver had managers; these four did not, so they were pinned and never bumped.
Velero e2e: the external-resizer sidecar. The snapshotter and the hostpath driver had managers; these four did not, so they were pinned and never bumped.
Velero e2e: the external-health-monitor sidecar. The snapshotter and the hostpath driver had managers; these four did not, so they were pinned and never bumped.

rclone e2e: the rclone release the suite installs and asserts it is running. The suite records what ONE named release makes of this proxy, so 'latest' would make the claim move under its own feet (ADR 0006 D7).
s3cmd e2e: the s3cmd release the suite installs from PyPI. pypi rather than github-releases because the up-script installs it with pip, which is what resolves its python-dateutil dependency.

The helm-unittest plugin version the Makefile installs and the Helm Chart job in test-pipeline.yml therefore runs. It gates semantic-release, so the rule below keeps it off automerge: a plugin bump must not reach a release gate unread.

packageRules.description: The helm-unittest plugin is installed over the network by a job that gates semantic-release, so an upstream tag move must not merge itself. Everything else in this repository defaults to automerge: true; this is the exception.

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits must stay in the generation @semantic-release/commit-analyzer and release-notes-generator are built on (conventional-changelog-angular 8.x, writer 8.x). The 10.x line changes the preset shape and needs Node 22; it once broke the release. Bump it only together with a semantic-release generation that moves its own conventional-changelog dependencies.
Velero e2e pins move together and only merge on a green e2e job. The chart lags the release (chart 12.1.0 ships appVersion 1.18.1), so a chart bump and an image bump must never land separately.

The client e2e pins. A client release is not a dependency bump like any other: these suites record what one named version of one named client makes of this proxy, and a new version can change that verdict — which is the finding, not a flake. Never automerged; the suite has to be run and its verdict table read before the pin moves.

All Go version pins move in one PR: the Containerfile image (dockerfile manager, depName golang) and the go directive in go.mod (custom manager above, depName go). The Makefile derives its pin from the Containerfile and CI reads go.mod, so nothing else needs touching; see CLAUDE.md, Go toolchain version.
